concepts.name: 팝 아케이드
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: high fidelity game HUD art direction proposal, one fully rendered 16:9 landscape gameplay screenshot, target 1920x1080, edge-to-edge game, no phone frame, no presentation border, no captions outside game.
Primary request: Develop TOY RUSH, an existing 4-player co-op fantasy hero tower defense game. The user wants UI concepts with visual inspiration from Supercell Brawl Stars and mo.co. This is one of three different art directions.
Input image: existing TOY RUSH screenshot, reference for world, recognizable characters, landscape aspect and functions. Treat as reference, not an image to precisely edit. Improve interface design dramatically while keeping the toy-game identity.
Scene/backdrop: high slightly tilted overhead view of a bright green stylized toy forest with branching pale sandy path, round canopy trees, faceted boulders, small blue barracks tower at slightly right of center and a violet-haired Queen archer next to it, little goblins along the right-side path, small red King at left-middle, purple pointy-hat Wizard near top-middle and orange-haired axe Valkyrie near lower-right. Rounded simple chibi vinyl figurines exactly like reference, not realistic anatomy. Soft toy shadows. Do not reimagine as cinematic detailed fantasy art. Battlefield occupies at least 70 percent of visible area; keep middle clear except selected-tower contextual UI.
UI structure consistent in all three alternatives:
Top-left horizontal compact resource bar with pink heart "20", gold coin "430".
Top-center compact wave card, exact text "웨이브 3/10", then small "다음 웨이브 18초". A small attached secondary yellow horn button "F" to call early.
Left below resources four compact team rows, each with distinct King, Queen, Wizard, Valkyrie face portrait and hp bar. Colored lane indicators BLUE, CORAL, GREEN, YELLOW respectively, reinforced with "N", "E", "S", "W". Only show exact short names "KING", "QUEEN", "WIZARD", "VALKYRIE". Queen is selected local character, its row clearly highlighted. No paragraphs of text.
Top-right a compact readable circular minimap occupying 16 percent of width, clean green terrain and ivory four branching routes to center castle, four colored teammate dots and small red enemy dots. Tiny compass ticks. The same minimap topology as the reference.
Bottom-center compact hero skill dock, Queen face portrait at left, label "퀸", blue "Lv. 3" chip, hp "180/180" and a slim gold XP bar. To right exactly TWO big skill icons, Q with a fan of arrows in a ready state and E with a rolling silhouette darkened with "4s" cooldown ring. Readable keyboard key badges "Q" and "E". No joystick, no extra skills, no attack button.
Selected blue barracks at mid-right: subtle white selection ring around it. Nearby small two-action radial menu with yellow upward arrow coin button at top "110", sale coin button at bottom "42". To its right compact tooltip with exact text "병영 Lv.1 → Lv.2", one line "병사 3명 · 길 막기", primary button "업그레이드 110", secondary modest "판매 42". Do not place tooltip on the minimap or the hero bar; preserve visibility of tower and enemies.
Functional constraints: visual hierarchy resources/wave > compact team/minimap > contextual tower upgrade > skills. Corner safe margins 24 px, controls unobstructed and completely on-screen, legible UI. Use the exact few Korean labels and English names above, avoid other text. UI appears shippable and original. No Supercell logos or existing franchise characters. No mobile control joysticks, shooting controls, card shops, new resources, battlepass, equipment or mechanics. No flashy VFX occluding combat. Prioritize HUD refinement, keeping same low-poly toy world recognizable.

Art direction A: POP ARCADE, vivid Brawl Stars-inspired bold graphic design. Chunky electric cobalt blue panels and saturated yellow primary upgrade button, coral danger accent, white text with controlled thick dark navy outlines. Hard-edged offset darker lower extrusion on interactive buttons, readable rounded heavy condensed lettering, colorful original toy hero portrait stickers. Team rows use compact blue frame, distinct lane color tabs, saturated green hp bar. Top-center wave panel has a punchy angular comic-banner silhouette but no giant typography. Q and E buttons are separate blue squared buttons with thick rounded borders and yellow key badges. Yellow and blue radial choices. Subtle halftone only inside a couple UI panels; no scattered decorations. Minimap framed blue with a clean navy outline. Interface playful, competitive and instantly readable. Forest greens slightly quieted so UI dominates; world and toys match reference. No noisy action lines outside controls.

Understated small drop shadows, no glassmorphism, no neon glow, no cyberpunk, no fake gold filigree. Gently quieter greens in same toy forest. Overall confident fresh contemporary and spacious, like friendly product design inside a charming action game. Exact gameplay functionality remains.
